facts.fact: MINTTICS's legislation page lists Despacho Presidencial 129/19 of 22 July 2019 as approving the Livro Branco das TIC 2019-2022 and repealing Despacho Presidencial 71/11 of 12 September.
The despacho approves the Livro Branco das TIC for the period 2019-2022 (date given is the despacho's, 22 July 2019).
The ministry's official site carries the despacho with a download-file link (the page is dated 22 July 2019).
